description: The frozen swing-v1.1.0 baseline. Raw prior-week return, reversed, at 10% weight, cost-gated to names above the reversal minimum dollar volume.
Reversal leg removed. Its 10% is redistributed proportionally across the four continuation legs, so the evidence ordering among the survivors is unchanged.

Reversal leg replaced with a residualized reversal at the same 10%: the prior-week return orthogonalized by one cross-sectional OLS against a constant, the row's own sector mean prior-week return, and the four continuation leg z-scores. The residual is what the leg scores. This is the construct Da, Liu & Schaumburg (Management Science 2014) find survives in modern samples.
